remarks: Move right into this pristine 1st floor unit. Special features include: engineered hardwood floors throughout; a den off the living room which would make a perfect home office (per association cannot be used as a second bedroom); the eating area off the kitchen opens onto the deck overlooking the pond; the spacious master bedroom has a huge walk-in closet; bathrooms are updated; heat and hot water are included in the rent. The Rolling Ridge complex is an architectural gem with Tudor architecture, a lovely pond, fountains, an in-ground pool, paddle tennis court and dog park. Shops and restaurants are within walking distance, and the Merritt Parkway is a short drive away. There is convenient parking and extra storage in the basement. Agent/Owner. Photos were taken prior to current tenant. Available 11/18. Excellent credit is a must!
